text:
Olivia Chen: Loop for candidate Samir Patel (Sr SWE) — recruiter flagged as remote-only. Need final logistics: loaner, timezone, and calendar invite.
Ravi Kumar: Do we need a loaner or can they use their personal machine? Natalie mentioned VPN restrictions.
Maya Singh: Recruiter confirms candidate prefers company loaner for VPN and corp certs. Also request: no interviews after 6pm local time.
Olivia Chen: Ok, no hotel. We'll ship a loaner. Ravi — can you time the shipment so it arrives before interview? Include charger and a basic 'connect' readme.
Ravi Kumar: Yep. Need address + signed LOA. Natalie, can you send LOA and confirm shipping address & phone?
Natalie (Recruiter): Sending LOA in 1:1. Candidate in IST (UTC+5:30) and prefers Tue/Thu next week. Address + phone sent via secure note.
Maya Singh: Panel is majority PST folks — we need a time that respects "no later than 6pm IST" constraint. Suggestions?
Olivia Chen: Quick math: PST (UTC-8) vs IST (UTC+5:30) = 13.5 hour difference. If candidate wants <= 18:00 IST, that means interview must end by 18:00 IST. Example: 04:30 PST = 18:00 IST. So panel would need to start very early (04:30 PST) to hit the candidate's limit.
Ravi Kumar: Oof early. I'll check with panel volunteers. If too painful, we can offer recorded/async alternative for one interviewer or pick a different day with timezone reps.
Olivia Chen: Proposed slot: Tue 2026-04-07 04:30 PST / 16:00 IST (4pm IST) — that keeps candidate earlier than 6pm. Wait re-check: 04:30 PST = 18:00 IST, so to be 16:00 IST we should schedule at 02:30 PST. Let's avoid calculation bugs — call it: we need the panel to start between 02:30–04:30 PST depending on length.
Morgan: I can do 04:30 PST that day (will join early).
Diego: 04:30 PST works for me too.
Kim: I can join but prefer if one interviewer does recorded pair-coding as backup (late hour personal constraints).
Olivia Chen: Good — Natalie, please capture the agreed fallback (recorded pair-coding + reschedule buffer) in the invite and candidate note. Ravi — start a loaner ticket with 3 business days lead time.
PeopleOps Bot: reminder: Loaner shipments require 3 business days lead time. Submit via https://redwood/internal/loaner-request.
Ravi Kumar: Created ticket LOANER-2026-558. ETA to ship: 2026-03-31. I'll post tracking once label is printed.
Natalie (Recruiter): Invite draft sent to panel — flagged for early start. I'll attach resume + panel prep doc and LOA. Candidate confirmed Tue/Thu preference; I picked Tue per initial ask.
Olivia Chen: Thanks. Please include explicit dial-in + Zoom + contingency: recorded session link and a short troubleshooting checklist: `-- test VPN 15m prior -- test zoom audio 10m prior`.
Ravi Kumar: Updated ticket with candidate address/phone and LOA received. Label pending.
PeopleOps Bot: shipment label created — tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 (est delivery 2026-03-31).
Natalie (Recruiter): Invite out to candidate + panel. Candidate replied: "Confirmed — thank you, I appreciate the loaner." :thumbsup:
Olivia Chen: Great. I'll follow up with a short post-interview feedback doc request for the panel. Thanks everyone.
